fixtureFidelity.router: RouterNGModel: Router NG first-empty-pool-slot break (route[2i+3]==0 => stop, deliver route[2i+2]); empty pool slot / empty output / unknown pair revert; per-hop 'Received nothing' on zero output. Replaces upstream MockCurveRouter (last-non-zero rule copied from the harvester, CODE-007(2)).
fixtureFidelity.strategy: InvStrategy: reported surplus (seen by calculateClaimAmount) != delivered (deliverBps 50%..100% honest, 50%..120% adversarial). Upstream MockYieldStrategy delivers exactly the estimate (CODE-007(3)).
fixtureFidelity.tokens: OZ ERC20 (named ERC20InsufficientAllowance error, distinguishable from the harvester's intended Panic(0x11) surplus underflow).
fixtureFidelity.v4: Real v4-core PoolManager, native-ETH/USDC 0.3% pool, raw 1:1, 1e20 liquidity over +/-120 ticks.
fixtureFidelity.sya: Upstream MockSYA (live claim ordering, pricing on delivered amount, Burn/Ignore NFT modes) + MockERC1155 authorized-burner NFT.
fixtureFidelity.seededState: All three strategies hold pending yield at deployment (USDe 1000e18, DOLA 500e18, USDC 200e6); USDe direct route, DOLA 2-hop via crvUSD; actors hold 5 NFT units each.

configs.HarvestSystemHonest: Owner registers only Router-NG-contiguous routes; no third-party donations; delivered <= reported. Any safety failure here would be NEW.
configs.HarvestSystemAdversarial: Owner may register any route that passes setRoute (gap shapes, empty first pool); third parties donate dust/NFT strays/forced ETH; delivered up to 120% of reported.

invariants.name: invariant_stateless
invariants.description: After every successful harvest the harvester holds 0 reward token, 0 ETH and 0 of every NON-EXEMPT strategy token (donated balances of an exempt strategy's token are excluded: they are a donor's own dust, sold on the next non-exempt harvest).

invariants.name: invariant_noStranding
invariants.description: No harvester token balance (USDC, USDe, DOLA, crvUSD intermediate) increases across a successful harvest: the caller's paid-for yield is never left behind.

invariants.name: invariant_nft
invariants.description: With nftIndex != 0 the harvester ends with 0 units of the index; caller NFT delta == strays refunded - (1 if SYA burns). With nftIndex == 0 the harvester's NFT balance never grows.

invariants.name: invariant_minEthOut
invariants.description: On success, ethOut >= minEthOut and the caller's ETH increases by exactly the returned ethOut.

invariants.name: invariant_v4DeltasZero
invariants.description: Read in the same tx after harvest: PoolManager NonzeroDeltaCount == 0, harvester currencyDelta(USDC) == currencyDelta(ETH) == 0, PoolManager locked.

invariants.name: invariant_conservation
invariants.description: Across a harvest the per-token total over all holders (harvester, PoolManager, SYA, router, actors, strategies) and the ETH total (caller + PoolManager + harvester) are unchanged.

invariants.name: invariant_syaPaymentExact
invariants.description: SYA's USDC balance increases by exactly the payment SYA itself computed on delivered amounts (MockSYA.totalCollected delta).

invariants.name: invariant_allowancesReset
invariants.description: After every harvest and at every state: harvester allowance to SYA and to the router is 0 for every token.

invariants.name: invariant_routeRegistrySound
invariants.description: Every configured route has path[0] == token and, under REAL Router NG semantics (first empty pool slot terminates), delivers sya.rewardToken().

invariants.name: invariant_liveness_dust
invariants.description: No harvest reverts because of a third-party dust balance of a non-delivering strategy token (router 'Received nothing' or RouteNotConfigured on a token that delivered nothing).

invariants.name: invariant_liveness_naturalDust
invariants.description: No harvest reverts because a strategy's own delivery is below the router's dust threshold.

invariants.name: invariant_liveness_overDelivery
invariants.description: No harvest reverts on SYA's allowance pull because delivered yield exceeds calculateClaimAmount * 1.01.

invariants.name: invariant_liveness_other
invariants.description: No harvest reverts for any reason outside the expected set (ZeroAmount, NoValidNFT, 'Invalid index', InsufficientEthOut, Unprofitable, RouteNotConfigured for a delivering unrouted token, Panic(0x11) under price shock / divergent route, Router NG empty-pool errors under a divergent route).
